svg.title: What the lights tell the drive team
svg.desc: Two legends. The indicator light: solid red means no tag in view; blinking red means only the other alliance's tags are in view, so check the magnet; blinking blue one of our tags; solid blue two; green three or more; blinking orange an auto waiting for a tag; blinking yellow an auto launching. The LED strip: underglow red for the red alliance, underglow blue for blue, the whole strip yellow while pollen is in the robot, dark when cleared.
svg.text: What the lights tell the drive team
Read during INIT before every match: point the robot at our hive and check the colors.
Indicator light (goBILDA RGB, on a servo port)
Red
No tag in view
Blinking red
Tags in view, but the other alliance's. Check the alliance magnet.
Blinking blue
One of our tags in view
Blue
Two of our tags in view
Green
Three or more of our tags: locked on the hive
Blinking orange
AUTO: holding still, waiting for one of our tags
Blinking yellow
AUTO: launching
LED strip (goBILDA Prism driver, 36 LEDs)
LED 0
LED 12
LED 35
Red alliance: underglow red, LEDs 12 to 35
A magnet near the sensor at INIT. Stays on for the whole match.
Blue alliance: underglow blue
No magnet, or no sensor in the configuration.
Pollen in the robot: the whole strip yellow
Plus one rumble on the operator's gamepad. Half a second after the
last ball leaves, the underglow comes back.
Dark: cleared
At INIT, and for an instant as pollen comes or goes.
The underglow redraws on the next loop.
Dashed ring = blinking, 300 ms on and 300 ms off. The strip reads no gamepad: the underglow and the pollen yellow run by themselves.
Colors are goBILDA servo positions: red 0.28, orange 0.333, yellow 0.388, green 0.5, blue 0.611.
